ns2:course.label: Harpsichord
ns2:course.description: Instruction in harpsichord at the advanced undergraduate and graduate level. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. (Summer session, 1 or 2 undergraduate or graduate hours.) Prerequisite: Primarily for music majors, junior standing or above. Passing of an audition is required prior to initial registration in any applied music course as approved by the faculty of the appropriate applied music division.
